interpretations.cases: A case is one row of cases_clean.csv (9,958 rows). No de-duplication: the duplicate case numbers (e.g. 33669 twice in one order), the case-number '0' row and the blank-violation row all count as cases.
interpretations.rounding: Rounded values use Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP (a human's rounding) on the exact ratio, not Python's round() (half to even). Percentages are 100*numerator/denominator rounded to 1 decimal; Q7 means are rounded to whole dollars. supporting_counts records where half-even would differ.
interpretations.year: Year = the year of order_date (the order's date), as the preamble says; damage_date is not used.
interpretations.base_section_qualifier: Qualifier = a parenthesized group of 2+ letters (hyphens allowed), e.g. (expire), (locator-error), as the preamble now states; single-letter or digit groups such as (h), (i), (a)(2), (3)(b) are part of the base section, so 20(a)(3)(b) is its own base section, not 20(a)(2). Base section = cite minus 'IC 8-1-26-' minus the qualifier. Base section 16(h) therefore includes 16(h) with any qualifier; 16(i) is a different base section. The one blank-cite row has base '' and stays in 'all cases' denominators.
interpretations.headline_penalty: Headline penalty = the first '$' amount in the recommendation text as printed, no other arithmetic. 'Training or $5,000 if respondent fails to complete training' therefore has headline $5,000 (the first $ amount, even though the sentence is a fallback penalty). '$$1000' = 1000; '$3, 500' = 3500; '$1,500, respondent can complete training ...' = 1500; '$3,000+ training...' = 3000; '$1,500 fine plus ...' = 1500. Text with no '$' (Warning letter..., Training (completed ...), '3000', '0', '.5000', 'Other', 'Violation found; no penalty recommended', blank) = $0. Totals/parentheticals later in the text ('($4,500)') are ignored.
interpretations.utility_respondent: Utility respondent = respondent.lstrip(' ').lower().startswith(prefix.lower()) for any of the 13 prefixes; plain prefix test (no word boundary, no punctuation or inner-space normalising). A blank respondent is a non-utility respondent ('every other case').
interpretations.contains_phrase: 'contains the words/word X (any capitalization)' = X.lower() is a substring of recommendation.lower(). Substring, not whole-word: 'Trainingalready completed' and 'trainingIt is very...' count for 'training'. Variants such as 'trained', 'Train' do not match. 'no ticket escalation' and 'No ticket escalation' both count for 'ticket escalation'. Whole-word counts are in supporting_counts for sensitivity.
interpretations.Q1: Denominator = all 9,958 cases (including the blank-cite row); numerators count 16(h) / 20(a)(2) with or without a qualifier.
interpretations.Q2: Year counts include every row (duplicates and unusable rows included). Year is order year.
interpretations.Q3: Mean (arithmetic) of headline penalties over cases with headline penalty > $0 and base section 16(h) (any qualifier) / 20(a)(2); sum / count, rounded half-up to whole dollars. statistics.median is no longer used.
interpretations.Q5: Denominator = cases with headline penalty > 0 (any respondent type); numerator = those whose recommendation contains 'training' (substring, case-insensitive).
interpretations.Q6: Normalisation exactly as worded: lowercase; delete every character that is not a letter, a digit or a space (str.isalnum() or ' '), no replacement, so 'C S U, Inc.' -> 'c s u inc'; collapse runs of spaces to one and trim; then once drop a final whole word if it is exactly inc/llc/co/corp/corporation/company ('x co inc' -> 'x co'; a name that is only a suffix word becomes ''). No other merging (spelling variants stay separate). Percent denominator = all non-utility cases (blank respondent included); numerator = non-utility cases whose normalized name has >= 5 non-utility cases. Counting is of case rows, not unique case numbers.
interpretations.Q7: Mean = sum of headline penalties (all non-utility cases of that order year, $0 cases included) / number of those cases; rounded half-up to whole dollars.
interpretations.Q8: Counts all respondent types and all years (no filter). Matches 'no ticket escalation' as well as any other mention (the question says 'containing'). Mode of the headline penalty (first $ amount) among those cases; a tie would be reported as a list.
interpretations.Q9: Key = other_party.strip().lower() only (no punctuation or inner-space changes). The answer is given lowercased; the printed capitalisations are in supporting_counts. Blank other_party is not a name (cannot win) but stays in the denominator (all non-utility cases). Percent = cases with that other party / all non-utility cases.
interpretations.Q10: Denominator = all base-16(h) cases, including those with no qualifier; 16(i) cases are excluded.
